messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "contact doctor or seek emergency medical attention for uncontrolled bleeding"
set: ["contact doctor or seek emergency medical attention for uncontrolled bleeding", "seek emergency medical attention", "seek emergency medical attention for bleeding that will not stop", "caregiver should seek emergency medical attention", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if bleeding will not stop", "seek emergency medical attention for black or bloody stools", "seek emergency medical attention for coughing up blood", "seek emergency medical attention for blood in urine", "seek emergency medical attention or call your doctor right away", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if fall or hit head", "seek emergency medical attention for vomiting that looks like coffee grounds", "call your doctor or seek emergency medical attention if you have black or bloody stools", "seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222", "call your doctor or seek emergency medical attention if you have blood in your urine", "seek emergency medical attention if you have symptoms such as chest pain or pressure", "seek medical attention for fast, slow, or irregular heartbeat, shortness of breath, or fainting"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "seek emergency medical attention",
    "seek emergency medical attention for bleeding that will not stop",
    "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if bleeding will not stop",
    "seek emergency medical attention or call your doctor right away",
    "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if fall or hit head",
    "seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222",
    "call your doctor or seek emergency medical attention if you have black or bloody stools",
    "call your doctor or seek emergency medical attention if you have blood in your urine",
    "seek emergency medical attention if you have symptoms such as chest pain or pressure"
  ],
  "alias": "seek emergency medical attention"
}
